title: Dutch Pancake with Caramelized Corn
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional pancakes, featuring caramelized corn and a crispy Dutch-inspired crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, sugar, and melted butter.
Heat a 12-inch non-stick skillet or oven-safe pancake pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the skillet and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the pancake with a spatula and flip. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
In a separate pan, caramelize the corn over medium heat for 10-12 minutes.
Season with kosher salt to taste.
To assemble, place a pancake on a serving plate and top with caramelized corn.
